title: Asiad: Filipinas overwhelmed by Japan, bow out of contention
summary: Host nation Japan put on a first half masterclass against the Philippines in the women's football quarterfinals at the 2026 Asian Games, claiming a 4-0 win at the Shizuoka Stadium on Friday night.
